title: Knowing God's Will
definition: Knowing God's will means seeking, understanding, and obeying what God has revealed while trusting Him with what He has not revealed.
summary: Knowing God's will begins with Scripture, wisdom, prayer, and obedient trust.
christFocus: Jesus perfectly did the Father's will and teaches His people to seek God's kingdom and obey His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God has clearly revealed His moral will in Scripture. Believers do not need to guess whether God wants holiness, love, truth, prayer, justice, gratitude, and obedience.

When making decisions not directly named in Scripture, believers seek wisdom through prayer, biblical principles, wise counsel, circumstances, and surrendered hearts. Knowing God's will is not about decoding secret signs but walking faithfully in what He has revealed.

The believer can trust God with hidden things. The goal is not control over the future but faithful obedience today.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people become paralyzed trying to find secret direction while neglecting what God has already commanded. Knowing God's will matters because it brings clarity, peace, and responsibility to decision-making.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Start with what Scripture clearly commands. Pray for wisdom, seek godly counsel, examine motives, and take faithful steps while trusting God with the outcome.
